rule: Earth holds its ground: its skills raise, use or break your stone, wind up Braced, break poise, and call the enemy onto you.

skills.name: Slingstone
skills.summary: A slow, heavy stone thrown Braced: 70 damage, 45 poise, it stops what it hits mid-swing, and it Taunts it for 4 s - it drops what it was doing and comes for you. Thrown into your own stone, it shatters it.
skills.verb_fit: Dig is "tear into the ground and bring stone up to throw": a stone torn up and thrown, and for the tank the throw is a challenge: the archer at the back now walks to you.

new_mechanics.name: taunted
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, the skill's status_s (elites half, heavy_lasts_mult 0.5): it comes for whoever taunted it and attacks only them. A ranged or support enemy walks in to strike in melee instead of keeping its distance or tending its friends, and lures, decoys and thralls do not draw it. Keys: forced_target 'source', closes_in. Applying it again refreshes it. Used by Earth (many at once) and Metal (one).

good_modifiers.word: Heavy Stone: more poise, and the taunt holds

bad_modifiers.why: Braced already; and a thrown stone cannot be rooted. Falls back to a little power
a stone in flight has nothing that lasts but the taunt; it only stretches that
it acts on the enemy; falls back to a cost cut

skills.change_note: The tank's ranged starter is now a taunt: 120 -> 70 damage, cost 12 -> 8, and it Taunts for 4 s. Its reach to the back rank is its point, not its damage.

skills.name: Landslide Blow
skills.summary: A broad, slow, crushing blow across 100 degrees, Braced: 2x strike damage and 60 poise to everything in it, and each one is Taunted for 4 s. It moves nobody, and shatters every stone of yours in its arc.
skills.verb_fit: Crumble is "break stone and guard": the blow breaks guards across a whole front, and everything whose guard you broke turns on you.

good_modifiers.word: Heavy Landslide: hold it for a harder blow
Weighted Landslide: more poise, and the taunt holds

bad_modifiers.why: a blow cannot go underground; through on a sweep does nothing. Falls back
a blow has nothing that lasts but the taunt; falls back to a little power
a planted, Braced blow does not travel; falls back

skills.change_note: Lighter and wider for the tank: 3.2x -> 2x, 80 -> 60 poise, arc 60 -> 100 degrees, wind-up 0.6 -> 0.5 s, cost 16 -> 12, and everything it hits is Taunted.

skills.name: Bedrock Shove
skills.summary: Shoulder first, 3.5 m, Braced throughout. The first enemy you meet is thrown 2 m and loses 50 poise (a heavy one stops you dead and loses 60), and everything within 3 m of where you stop is Taunted for 4 s.
skills.verb_fit: Root is "anchor, stand firm": you move as the ground moves, unstoppable and Braced, and where you stop is where you stand - and they come to you there.

good_modifiers.word: Heavy Shove: the taunt reaches and holds
Shaking Shove: the stop shakes a wider ring

bad_modifiers.why: under the floor you cannot shoulder anyone; it should not act
a dash has nothing that lasts but the taunt; falls back
it has no wind-up to cut; falls back to a little power

skills.change_note: Now the movement starter (Raise Slab was the third kit skill, but it does not move you). Cost 12 -> 8 (cheap tier), shove 3 -> 2 m, and it Taunts everything within 3 m of where you stop.

skills.name: Raise Slab
skills.summary: A wall of stone across your aim, up to 8 m away. It blocks movement and shots - theirs and yours - for 12 s. Three at a time.
skills.verb_fit: Raise is "stone up": the wall the area tank holds its ground behind.

good_modifiers.word: Distant Slab: raise it farther off
Hard Slab: it takes more to wear down

bad_modifiers.why: breaks the stone it is raising. The two cancel
a wall that lets you pass through; falls back
a wall that travels; falls back

skills.change_note: No longer a starter (Bedrock Shove is the movement starter). Numbers unchanged.

skills.name: Pillar
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: a circle is marked for half a second, then a column punches up - 90, 60 poise, interrupts - and stays as stone.
skills.verb_fit: Raise is "stone up": stone comes up under them and stays, more ground that is yours.

good_modifiers.word: Lasting Pillar: the stone stays longer
Toppling Pillar: it falls on them

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a column that is a pit. The two cancel
nothing to pass under; falls back
a column does not travel; falls back

skills.name: Sinkhole
skills.summary: Point, 9 m, 0.5 s wind-up (Braced): the floor drops into a pit 2.5 m across for 10 s. Enemies standing there fall in for 30 damage and 40 poise. Inside they are Mired and need 1.5 s to climb out; enemies walk round it, and shots fly over it. It counts as one of your three stones.
skills.verb_fit: Sink is "ground down, pits": terrain that takes a piece of the floor away from them.

good_modifiers.word: Caving Pit: the edges fall in on them
Crumbling Pit: more poise as they fall

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a pit that is a wall. The two cancel
a hole to go through; falls back
a hole does not travel; falls back

skills.name: Stonehide
skills.summary: 8 s Braced: 40% less damage, and nothing staggers or shoves you. You move 25% slower, and the ground within 2.5 m of you thickens: enemies in it are Mired.
skills.verb_fit: Harden is "solidify, armour": your skin turns to stone, and the ground round your feet with it.

new_mechanics.name: aura
new_mechanics.definition: A self_buff's aura {radius, tick_s, payload, pull_per_s} applies its payload every tick_s to each enemy within radius of the caster (a hold lands once per target per cast, as zones do) and drags them toward the caster at pull_per_s. It moves with you.

good_modifiers.word: Rooted Hide: you are Braced harder
Wide Hide: the thick ground reaches farther

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: breaking the stone you wear. The two cancel
a buff cannot go underground; falls back
your skin has no range; falls back to a cost cut

skills.change_note: Cost 12 -> 10, its 40% made explicit as incoming_mult, and a 2.5 m aura that Mires enemies beside you (the area tank's ground; it gives reach a field).

skills.name: Tremor
skills.summary: Everything within 5 m takes 50, is interrupted and Slowed for 3 s - and every stone you have standing shatters outward at once.
skills.verb_fit: Quake is "shake, unbalance": the whole area you stand in is shaken, and your stone with it.

good_modifiers.word: Burying Tremor: what it shakes is Pinned
Heavy Tremor: what it shakes is Taunted

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: stand firm while shaking. Braced already; falls back
a ring round you has nothing to pass through; falls back
a quake where you stand does not travel; falls back

skills.name: Cave-In
skills.summary: Point, 10 m, 0.4 s wind-up (Braced): rock comes down on a 3 m circle a full second later. Everything still under it takes 100 and 70 poise and is Stunned for 1 s, elites included. The rubble stays for 15 s: nothing can walk through it, but shots pass over. It counts as one of your three stones.
skills.verb_fit: Collapse is "bring the ground down and close a passage": a piece of the battlefield shut, with them under it.

good_modifiers.word: Sudden Cave-In: it comes down sooner
Lasting Rubble: the heap stays longer

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a passage through the fall it makes. The two cancel
a fall from above does not travel; falls back
lifts what it is burying; it should not act

skills.name: Millstone
skills.summary: For 6 s you are as heavy as the hill: nothing moves, staggers or throws you, and you walk at 60%. Every enemy within 6 m is drawn toward you, 1 m a second, and Taunted while it stays inside. When it ends the ground settles under you: everything within 3 m takes 60 and 40 poise.
skills.verb_fit: Weigh is "add mass": you are the heaviest thing in the room, the room leans toward you, and then it settles.

new_mechanics.name: on_end
new_mechanics.definition: A self_buff's on_end payload hits every enemy within its radius of the caster once, when the buff runs out.

new_mechanics.name: immovable (self)
new_mechanics.definition: While a self_buff with immovable lasts, the caster cannot be shoved, pulled, staggered, thrown Aloft or knocked down; damage still lands.

good_modifiers.word: Long Millstone: you stay heavy longer
Grinding Millstone: the settling shakes wider
Stone Millstone: the settling hits harder

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: lighten what you are making heavy. The two cancel
a weight that moves is no anchor; it fights the whole skill
under the floor nothing can see you to come for you; it should not act

skills.name: Quarry Throw
skills.summary: Hold to tear a boulder out of the floor (rooted and Braced, up to 1.5 s), release to lob it at the cursor, up to 14 m. 110 to 280 damage in 2.5 m by how long you held, 80 poise, and it leaves rubble: a stone that also slows enemies within 2 m of it by 40%.
skills.verb_fit: Buoy is "lighten: lift a thing out of the ground to throw it": the boulder is made light enough to throw, and lands as new ground.

good_modifiers.word: Heavy Quarry: a longer, harder hold
Standing Quarry: the rubble stands as a full stone

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: add weight to what you are lightening to throw. The two cancel
you are already rooted to throw it; falls back
you cannot walk while you hold it; falls back

skills.change_note: Moved from Dig to the new Buoy rune. Tank tier: 150-400 -> 110-280, cost 22 -> 18, reflux 1.0 -> 0.4 (earth's usual).

skills.name: Cairn
skills.summary: One enemy within 8 m, 0.4 s wind-up (Braced): earth heaps over it. It is Buried for 2.5 s - it cannot move or act, and blows land on the stone, not on it. Shatter the cairn and the one inside takes 120 and is Staggered. Elites are Pinned instead. The cairn counts as one of your three stones.
skills.verb_fit: Bury is "cover over with earth": one enemy taken out of the fight under a heap of it.

good_modifiers.word: Hard Cairn: it takes more to break

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: unearth what you bury. The two cancel
a passage out of the heap; it should not act
a heap does not travel; falls back

skills.change_note: Tank tier: cost 14 -> 12. Kind is smite (as built; the draft's new:seize).

skills.name: Burrow
skills.summary: 0.3 s wind-up (Braced), then you go under the floor and come up 6 m on, 0.4 s later, passing beneath enemies, stone and shots. Where you surface the ground heaves: enemies within 1.5 m lose 40 poise and are pushed 1.5 m off.
skills.verb_fit: Tunnel is "pass through the ground": the tank's way to reach a runner or leave a bad spot, without ever leaving the ground.

good_modifiers.word: Wide Burrow: the heave reaches farther
Calling Burrow: what the heave throws comes back for you

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: close the passage you are in. It should not act
anchored, you cannot tunnel; falls back
a passage has nothing that lasts; falls back
